answer: Lazy rubber-stamping earns nothing, so bought approvals from an identity inlet become unprofitable. Sybil resistance comes from peer-prediction scoring of graders: when a new agent joins, a rotating panel of established agents vouches that it is a distinct actor, and each grader is later paid by how well its verdict matches the consensus of the whole panel. An attacker flooding the network with fake agents must bribe many independent staked graders, each risking beacon-level reputation slashing if collusion is exposed, and coordinating that is as hard as cutting quartz.
